buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Pre-qualification Criteria: 1) Past work experience: Bidder shall have carried out similar works involving supply, erection, installation, testing and commissioni ng of similar electrical works involving Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of HT (11KV or abo ve) electrical systems consisting of following (submitted scope shall consist of following works in one or m ore completed contracts work-order/contract) in a Fertilizer/Refinery/ Petrochemical/Petroleum/Chemical/S teel/LNG/Oil and Gas Company in last 7 years. The completed and executed works shall consist of all the following points: a. Supply and installation of cable trays minimum 300 m wide and having a cumulative length of not less t han 400 meters in a single executed order. b. Laying of 11 kV or above power cable having conductor size 240 sq.mm or above, with a cumulative laid length of not less than 400 meters in a single executed order. c. Testing and commissioning of at least one (1) HT motor of 11 kV or Installation or Commissioning of at

least one (1) HT motor feeder of minimum 11KV in a single executed order. d. Termination of 11 kV or above power cables having conductor size 240 sq.mm or above in a single exec uted order. The above activities (as per conditions mentioned in aforesaid sub points a, b, c, d) may have been execut ed under one or more completed contracts/Work-orders, provided that all the specified experience has bee n acquired within the prescribed period. i. As a documentary evidence, bidder shall submit copy of valid executed work-order/service order/purchas e order indicating the detailed scope of work including SOR/BOQ. The SOR / BOQ must include the Similar Works indicated above along with valid work completion certificate (duly signed and stamped by end user) . NOTE: Submitted PO /WO shall be issued and executed during the last seven years ending the last day of month previous to the one in which this subject tender is floated/issued ii. In case a Work Completion Certificate is not available, Minutes of Meeting (MoM) confirming completion of work duly signed by the owner/end user or GeM SDAC, wherever applicable, shall also be acceptable. iii. The completion document shall clearly indicate: • Work Order Number • Contract Value • Contract Period • Actual Date of Completion iv. In addition to aforesaid documents, experience of bidder acquired as a sub-contractor can be accepted against submission of copy of completed work order/service order/purchase order in accordance to point n o:1 along with valid work completion certificate(duly signed and stamped by main contractor)/MoM of wor k completion (duly signed and stamped by main contractor) in regards to submitted order issued by the m ain-contractor in accordance to point no:i and ii and iii; and documents (like unpriced PO/LOI/SO copy, MoM of work completion having PO/SO number, etc.) establishing linkage between end-user and the main contr actor (who has sub-contracted work to bidder) along with other specified documents described in aforesai d points and documents establishing that the claimed work formed part of the main contract. Any docume nts (like Inward material entries, IMR, inspection reports, installation reports, etc.) to establish link betwee n bidder and end user can be asked by RCF from the bidder during scrutiny of received bids. It is the respo nsibility of bidder to provide such documents when asked. Failure to produce such documents may lead to disqualification of bidder. v. Bidder shall possess valid Class “A”/Super Grade/ Class-I Electrical contractor licensee issued by State o f Maharashtra. Self-attested copy of such valid license shall be submitted along with bid offer document. vi. Experience of works executed for the bidder's own organization, holding company, subsidiary, sister co ncern, affiliate, or Group Company shall not be considered for the purpose of qualification. 2) Average annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the previous financi al year (i.e. FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) should be at least Rs. 1.04 Crores. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than three years old, the average annual financial turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken i nto account. In this case, the financial turnover during last financial year/ the average financial turnover du ring preceding two financial years should be at least Rs. 1.04 Crores. Bidders shall submit CA certificate / CA audited Profit & Loss accounts, Balance sheets etc. indicating the a nnual turnover figures, in support of the same. The financial documents has to be CA audited/issued with membership number, seal, signed and with UDIN. 3) Ownership of company with name, addresses and telephone nos. of proprietors/ partners/directors. 4) Copy of Partnership deed /proprietorship/ Memorandum and article of association and certificate of incor poration as the case may be. 5) Net worth of the bidder should not be negative on 31.03.2025. It means the net worth of the bidder shou ld not be negative in the balance sheet of financial year 2024-2025. AND

Net worth of the bidder should have not eroded by more than 30% (thirty percent) in the last three years, ending 31.03.2025. It means the net worth of financial year 2024- 2025 should not be less than 70% comp ared to the net worth of financial year 2022- 2023. The bidder to submit the documentary proof e.g. audited balance sheet, P&L account etc. for the same or Net worth Certificate duly certified by practicing CA with membership number, seal, signed and UDIN numb er. In case the date of constitution/ incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the following will be ap plicable: � The Net Worth in each of these years should not be negative. � Net Worth in respect of the immediate previous financial year should not have eroded more 30 per cent t han that of its previously audited financial statement. 6) Shall submit Provident Fund Registration details, ESIC registration details, PAN details and GST details e tc. 7) Submission of Integrity Pact (Annexure-XIV) of NIT with date and sign on each page. BIDDER TO SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING DOCUMENT ATC/Packet:1: Scanned copy of i) No Deviation undertaking i.e. Annexure IIIA ii) Annexure-VI i.e. GST clauses iii) Annexure-XIIA i.e. as per 144(xi) of GFR-2017 iv) Annexure-XIV i.e. Integrity Pact(with date & Sign on each page) (Please print the documents on bidder's letter head with duly filled, signed and stamped by appropriate au thority)and signed stamped copy of corrigendum’s for subject tender uploaded on tender (CPP/GeM) portal , if any v) Acknowledgement receipt of online EMD paid/submission /valid MSE certificate /copy of BG towards EMD along with speed-post docket number if applicable. vi) Annexure XVIIA and XVIIB i.e. . Declaration of Status of Debarment Listing/ Blacklisting/ Holiday Listing and Undertaking about common Directors/ Partners/ Interest in other associated units/ companies.
